title: ElevenLabs vs Speechify: Which AI Voice Sounds More Human?
hook: Most AI voices still sound like robots, but two tools are changing that.

narration.text: Most AI voices still sound like robots, but two tools are changing that.
ElevenLabs is a dedicated AI voice platform built for creators and developers.
Speechify started as a text-to-speech reader and has grown into a full voice studio.
Round one: voice quality. ElevenLabs produces voices with natural pacing, breath sounds, and emotion.
Speechify sounds clean and clear, but it can feel slightly flat on longer passages.
For raw realism, ElevenLabs wins round one.
Round two: use case and features. Speechify shines for reading documents, articles, and study material aloud.
ElevenLabs focuses on voice cloning, dubbing, and content production at a professional level.
For everyday listening and productivity, Speechify wins round two.
Round three: pricing. Both offer free tiers, but costs rise quickly as usage scales up.
ElevenLabs charges based on characters generated, which adds up fast for long projects.
Speechify's subscription model is more predictable for regular daily listeners.
The overall winner is ElevenLabs if you need professional, human-sounding voice output.
Which tool would you actually use? Drop it in the comments, and follow for daily AI tool battles.

description: ElevenLabs and Speechify are two of the most talked-about AI voice tools right now, but they serve very different needs. This video breaks down voice quality, features, and pricing so you can pick the right one. Watch to find out which tool wins each round and which one suits your workflow.
